load_checkpoint: load a PyTorch model checkpoint from a local file, URL, or model zoo prefix
save_checkpoint: save a PyTorch model checkpoint with optional optimizer state and metadata to a file
load_state_dict: load a state_dict into a PyTorch module with flexible key matching and error reporting
get_state_dict: get the full state_dict of a PyTorch module including wrapped DDP modules
register_scheme: register a custom checkpoint loader scheme with CheckpointLoader for new URL prefixes
